keywords.def: the exit point of a letter (plural makharij, مخارج)
the empty space of the mouth and throat

questions.q: Read «وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ» (80:9) and name the makhraj of ه and خ.
questions.a: ه: deepest part of the throat; خ: part nearest the mouth.

questions.q: Throat-letter audit (pupil PDF): circle and label every throat letter in 'Abasa 80:1 to 10. Today's rota group recites 80:1 to 8 to the teacher.
Extend: write a pair of words where ع and ء change the meaning.
Stretch: why are throat letters the izhar letters for noon sakinah?
questions.a: They are far from the tongue tip where noon is made, so the noon stays clear.

questions.q: Which pair comes from the middle of the throat?
questions.a: A) ع ح. ع ح are the middle; ء ه the deepest; غ خ nearest the mouth.
in the throat, nearest the mouth
options: in the throat, nearest the mouth

questions.q: Think again: عَلِيم means 'all-knowing'; أَلِيم means 'painful'. One letter changes. What does that tell you about makharij?
questions.a: A letter from the wrong place can change the meaning completely, so makharij matter.
